title: 台积电洽谈加入马斯克得州晶圆厂项目
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's talk about the tech trade and TSMC could be getting a piece of Elon Musk's ambitious tariff ad project. Musk has confirmed the two sides are in discussions over possible
segments.zh: 来聊聊科技板块，台积电可能参与马斯克雄心勃勃的Terafab项目。马斯克已确认双方正在讨论可能的

segments.en: chip making partnership in Texas, potentially giving TSMC a role supplying Tesla, SpaceX, and XAI. Intel is already part of the project and shares sharply lower this morning.
segments.zh: 芯片制造合作，地点在得州，台积电或将为特斯拉、SpaceX和xAI供应芯片。英特尔已是项目一员，今早股价大幅走低。

segments.en: Bloomberg Equity's reporter, Carmen Wright, who joins us now. Carmen, is this just a big hit for Intel to potentially not be the only company involved in the tariff ad project?
segments.zh: 彭博Equity记者Carmen Wright加入我们。Carmen，这对英特尔来说是不是一大打击，可能不再是Terafab项目的唯一参与者？

segments.en: That's certainly how investors are reading it or reacting this morning. So we're seeing TSMC ADRs up a little bit right now. It's actually on track for a record high close and I was just
segments.zh: 市场参与者今早确实是这么解读和反应的。台积电ADR目前小幅上涨，有望创收盘新高，我刚

segments.en: checking it's up 60 percent this year. So those ADRs have just been on a run on the flip side Intel's off a little bit, off its lows, but still down about a percent and a half. And that stock
segments.zh: 查了一下，今年已涨60%。这些ADR一路走高，而英特尔则从低点小幅回升，但仍跌约1.5%。该股

segments.en: has really slumped over the last few months. It had a huge run-up April sort of kicked off a huge run-up. Part of that was because of this tariff ad news. It's a huge deal, especially for their
segments.zh: 近几个月确实低迷。4月曾有一波大涨，部分源于Terafab的消息。这是件大事，尤其对其

segments.en: foundry business. And so we've seen a pullback and it seems like there's still some skepticism from the market, especially sort of around this news. Even though it's not confirmed,
segments.zh: 代工业务而言。所以我们看到股价回落，市场似乎仍有些怀疑，尤其是围绕这一消息。尽管尚未确认，

segments.en: it's just musk saying that something could come of this relationship with TSMC.
segments.zh: 只是马斯克说与台积电的关系可能有所进展。

segments.en: I think what stuck out to me was here we had a note from Bernstein. They said something approaching 5 to 13 trillion of CAPEX in Elon Musk's vision. Now, obviously, we know his vision's grand
segments.zh: 我觉得伯恩斯坦的一份报告很引人注目。他们提到马斯克愿景中的资本开支接近5到13万亿美元。显然，我们知道他的愿景很宏大，

segments.en: and at this point why not just go to Mars because that seemed like enough money to do that.
segments.zh: 到这一步，为什么不干脆去火星呢，因为那笔钱看起来足够做到。
